repos.description: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
repos.summary_zh: Paperclip 是一个开源的 AI 代理编排平台，用于构建"零人力公司"。它通过 Node.js 服务端和 React 管理界面，协调多个 AI 代理（如 Claude、Cursor 等）协同完成商业目标。核心功能包括组织架构管理、预算控制、目标对齐和任务追踪，让管理者像使用任务管理器一样 overseeing 整个 AI 团队。平台支持任意能接收心跳信号的代理，提供统一仪表盘监控工作进展和成本，实现 24/7 自动化运营，同时保留人工审计和干预能力。
repos.summary_en: Paperclip is an open-source orchestration platform for building "zero-human companies." It coordinates teams of AI agents through a Node.js backend and React dashboard, enabling autonomous business operations. The platform provides organizational charts, budget governance, goal alignment, and cost tracking across multiple agents like Claude Code and Cursor. Supporting any agent that can receive heartbeats, it functions as a task manager for AI teams, allowing 24/7 autonomous execution with human oversight. Users can define business goals, assign AI roles, and monitor progress from a unified interface, with pre-built company templates coming soon.

repos.description: [EMNLP 2025 Demo] PDF scientific paper translation with preserved formats - 基于 AI 完整保留排版的 PDF 文档全文双语翻译，支持 Google/DeepL/Ollama/OpenAI 等服务，提供 CLI/GUI/MCP/Docker/Zotero
repos.summary_zh: PDFMathTranslate 是一款专注于科技文献的PDF翻译工具，核心优势在于完整保留原始排版。支持公式、图表、目录、注释等复杂元素的精准定位与翻译。集成Google、DeepL、Ollama、OpenAI等多引擎，提供CLI、GUI、Docker及Zotero插件等多种使用方式。适用于学术研究、论文阅读等场景，支持多语言互译，确保学术文档的专业性与可读性。
repos.summary_en: PDFMathTranslate is a specialized PDF translation tool for scientific documents that preserves original layouts with high fidelity. It accurately handles complex elements including formulas, charts, tables of contents, and annotations. The tool integrates multiple translation backends such as Google, DeepL, Ollama, and OpenAI, offering flexible deployment via CLI, GUI, Docker, and Zotero plugins. Designed for academic research and paper reading, it supports multilingual translation while maintaining the professional quality and readability of scholarly documents.

repos.description: Fully autonomous & self-evolving research from idea to paper. Chat an Idea. Get a Paper. 🦞
repos.summary_zh: AutoResearchClaw 是一个全自动化学术研究流水线，可将单一研究想法转化为会议级论文。系统采用23阶段流程，集成 arXiv 和 Semantic Scholar 真实文献检索、硬件感知的代码实验（GPU/MPS/CPU 自动检测）、多智能体同行评审（CodeAgent、BenchmarkAgent、FigureAgent）以及 NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR 的 LaTeX 模板生成。通过4层引用验证和AI-slop检测确保学术严谨性，无需人工干预即可完成从构思到论文的全流程。
repos.summary_en: AutoResearchClaw is a fully autonomous 23-stage research pipeline that transforms a single idea into a conference-ready academic paper. It integrates real literature search from arXiv and Semantic Scholar, hardware-aware sandboxed experiments with automatic GPU/MPS/CPU detection, multi-agent peer review (CodeAgent, BenchmarkAgent, FigureAgent), and generates LaTeX papers using NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR templates. The system ensures academic rigor through 4-layer citation integrity verification and AI-slop detection, delivering complete papers with verified BibTeX references without human intervention.

repos.description: Terraink: The Cartographic Poster Engine that creates unique and customizable map posters
repos.summary_zh: TerraInk 是一款基于 OpenStreetMap 数据的地图海报生成引擎。用户可通过地理编码搜索全球任意地点，自定义配色主题、地图图层和字体样式，并导出高分辨率 PNG 打印文件。采用 Bun+React+TypeScript 全栈技术，集成 MapLibre 实现矢量地图渲染，为设计师和地理爱好者提供便捷的创意地图制作工具。
repos.summary_en: TerraInk is a cartographic poster engine that generates unique, customizable map posters using real OpenStreetMap data. The platform offers smart geocoding for global locations, a rich theme system with dozens of curated color palettes, detailed map layer controls for roads, water, parks and buildings, and flexible typography options with Google Fonts integration. Built on a modern Bun+React+TypeScript stack with MapLibre for vector tile rendering, it enables users to export print-ready high-resolution PNG posters at any dimension, serving as an accessible creative tool for designers, geography enthusiasts, and anyone seeking personalized map art.

repos.description: 📜 A minimalist personal website embodying the purity of paper and freshness of snow.
repos.summary_zh: Shiro 是为 Mix Space 生态系统打造的极简主义个人网站主题，融合纸的纯净与雪的清新。基于 Next.js 16 App Router 构建，集成 Jotai 状态管理、Socket.IO 实时推送和 Motion 物理动画，Lighthouse 性能评分超 90。支持 Markdown 扩展、多语言、实时活动状态展示，提供优雅的写作与阅读体验。
repos.summary_en: Shiro is a minimalist personal website theme designed for the Mix Space ecosystem, embodying the purity of paper and freshness of snow. Built on Next.js 16 App Router with Jotai state management, Socket.IO real-time communication, and Motion physics-based animations, it achieves Lighthouse scores above 90. The theme features Markdown extensions, multilingual support via next-intl, real-time activity status, and a dedicated 'Recently' thoughts system, delivering an elegant writing and reading experience.

repos.description: GDM Science Skills to speed up agentic scientific workflows with better grounding and higher token efficiency. Integrate insights from AlphaGenome, AFDB, UniProt and 30+ other databases and tools.
repos.summary_zh: google-deepmind/science-skills 是 Google DeepMind 推出的科学技能集合，旨在加速 AI 智能体的科学工作流。它集成 AlphaGenome、AFDB、UniProt 等 30+ 数据库和工具，提供结构化指令、脚本资源，提升事实 grounding 和 token 效率。技能 spanning 基因组学、结构生物学、化学信息学及文献检索等领域，与 Google Antigravity 深度集成，助力高效科研任务。
repos.summary_en: The google-deepmind/science-skills repo delivers a bundle of agent skills from Google DeepMind to enhance scientific workflows for AI agents. It integrates over 30 databases and tools like AlphaGenome, AFDB, and UniProt, offering structured instructions and scripts for better grounding and token efficiency. Covering genomics, structural biology, cheminformatics, and literature search, these skills are optimized for the Google Antigravity platform, improving reliability and enabling efficient scientific automation.

repos.description: Curated tools, case studies and papers for reverse engineering websites, games, apps, binaries, firmware and protocols. Source-reviewed, English and Chinese.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库汇集了网站、游戏、应用、二进制、固件和协议等六大领域的逆向工程工具、案例与论文，共5000余项资源，均经来源审查，支持中英双语，为安全研究、漏洞挖掘和软件分析提供一站式导航。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates tools, case studies, and papers for reverse engineering websites, games, apps, binaries, firmware, and protocols. With over 5,000 resources, all source-reviewed and bilingual, it serves as a comprehensive hub for security research, vulnerability discovery, and software analysis.

repos.description: PDF scientific paper translation with preserved formats - 基于 AI 完整保留排版的 PDF 文档全文双语翻译，支持 Google/DeepL/Ollama/OpenAI 等服务，提供 CLI/GUI/Docker
repos.summary_zh: PDFMathTranslate-next是一款基于AI的PDF科学论文翻译工具，能完整保留原文排版、公式、图表及注释，支持Google、DeepL、Ollama、OpenAI等多种翻译服务。提供CLI、GUI和Docker三种部署方式，适用于学术研究者进行双语对照阅读与分析。依托BabelDOC框架实现高保真格式翻译，显著提升科研效率。
repos.summary_en: PDFMathTranslate-next is an AI-powered tool for translating scientific PDF papers while fully preserving layout, formulas, charts, and annotations. It supports multiple services including Google, DeepL, Ollama, and OpenAI, offering CLI, GUI, and Docker interfaces. Ideal for researchers to read and analyze academic documents bilingually. Built on BabelDOC for high-fidelity format retention, boosting research efficiency.

repos.description: Automatically crawl arXiv papers daily and summarize them using AI. Illustrating them using GitHub Pages.
repos.summary_zh: 该工具通过 GitHub Actions 每日自动爬取 arXiv 论文，并利用 DeepSeek AI 生成中文总结，完全无需服务器。提供个性化高亮、跨设备访问及 SKILL 可插拔过滤系统，帮助研究者零成本追踪 cs.CV、cs.AI 等领域最新进展，日均成本仅 0.2 元，支持偏好导出与一键部署。
repos.summary_en: This tool automatically crawls arXiv papers daily via GitHub Actions and generates Chinese summaries using DeepSeek AI, requiring zero server infrastructure. It offers personalized highlighting, cross-device compatibility, and a plug-and-play SKILL system for custom filtering, enabling researchers to track the latest advancements in cs.CV, cs.AI and other fields at near-zero cost (~0.2 CNY/day). Features include local preference storage, flexible date filtering, and seamless preference export for reproducible setups.

repos.description: ML algorithms implemented and derived from first-principles in Jupyter Notebooks and NumPy
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过 Jupyter Book 和 Marimo 构建交互式机器学习可视化平台，核心价值在于从第一性原理出发，使用 NumPy 纯 Python 实现神经网络、逻辑回归、PCA 等核心算法并配套数学推导。动态可视化训练过程，直观展示权重变化对损失函数的影响，是理解算法内部机制的顶级教学工具。
repos.summary_en: This project builds an interactive ML visualization platform using Jupyter Book and Marimo. It implements core algorithms—neural networks, logistic regression, PCA, etc.—from first principles with NumPy, accompanied by mathematical derivations. Dynamic visualizations show training progression and weight-loss relationships, serving as a premier educational tool for understanding algorithmic internals.

repos.description: 把英文论文读成舒服的中文：本地 PDF 论文翻译、原文对照、边读边问 AI、文献管理。Read English papers in comfortable Chinese.
repos.summary_zh: EasyRead 是一款本地论文阅读工具，支持 PDF 翻译、原文对照、边读边问 AI 和文献管理。通过多模型 API 实现舒适的中文阅读，帮助科研人员高效理解英文论文。
repos.summary_en: EasyRead is a local paper reading tool that supports PDF translation, side-by-side comparison, AI Q&A, and reference management. It leverages multiple model APIs to provide comfortable Chinese reading, helping researchers efficiently understand English papers.

repos.description: 每天早上打开通知，高质量论文摘要已经为你准备好 Ciallo～(∠・ω< )⌒☆
repos.summary_zh: 基于LLM的学术论文自动化监控系统，每日从ArXiv及20+顶级期刊抓取最新论文，通过双模型加权评分精准筛选，深度解析PDF全文并提取创新点、方法等核心维度。自动追踪关键词趋势生成可视化报告，支持邮件/企微等多渠道推送。提供Docker、GitHub Actions等部署方案，实现零人工干预的科研情报服务。
repos.summary_en: An LLM-powered academic paper monitoring system that automatically fetches daily submissions from ArXiv and 20+ top journals. It employs dual-model weighted scoring for precise filtering, performs in-depth PDF analysis to extract key dimensions like methodologies and innovations, tracks keyword trends with visual reports, and pushes notifications via email/WeCom等多渠道. Supports Docker/GitHub Actions deployments for fully automated research intelligence.

repos.description: Paperclip — search, read, and analyze 8M+ biomedical papers from the command line
repos.summary_zh: Paperclip 是一款命令行工具，专为高效检索与分析 800 万+生物医学文献而设计。支持自然语言/正则搜索、并行 AI 阅读、SQL 查询及图表视觉分析，无缝集成 Unix 工具链。可作为 MCP 服务器赋能 AI 智能体，快速完成文献综述、监管文档查询等科研任务。
repos.summary_en: Paperclip is a command-line tool for rapid search and analysis of over 8 million biomedical papers. It enables natural language/regex search, parallel AI reading, SQL queries, and vision-based figure analysis, integrating seamlessly with Unix tools. As an MCP server, it empowers AI agents to efficiently conduct literature reviews and regulatory document queries.

repos.description: Expert-thinking AGENTS.md profiles that teach AI agents to reason like senior scientists and engineers.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库收集503个专家级AGENTS.md配置文件，针对物理、生物、化学、工程等科学与工程领域，教导AI代理像资深从业者一样框架问题、选用工具数据库、评估证据、排查故障模式并规范报告。基于领域深度研究构建，采用开放AGENTS.md标准，兼容Cursor、Claude Code、OpenAI Codex等工具。核心价值是将通用AI转变为领域专精AI科学家，提升科研准确性与专业性，适用于数据分析、实验设计、方法起草和同行评审等场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates 503 expert AGENTS.md profiles for scientific and engineering professions, teaching AI agents to reason like senior practitioners by encoding domain-specific problem framing, tool and database selection, evidence evaluation, failure mode detection, and reporting standards. Research-grounded and built to pass field-expert validation, they leverage the open AGENTS.md standard for seamless integration with Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and other tools. The core value lies in transforming generalist AI into specialized AI scientists, enhancing precision in research workflows across physics, biology, chemistry, medicine, and engineering.

repos.description: A playground for live Metal shaders on iPhone, iPad, iPhone Duo, Apple TV, Apple Vision Pro and Apple Watch. Save any shader as a wallpaper.
